messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: METERS_TOKEN_DRIFT triggered (severity: P1) — routing to #incidents and @oncall-sre. Metrics: token_count_delta > 15% for 10m across multiple emitters.

oncall-sre: ack. I'm on it, grabbing runbook and paging billing-eng.

billing-eng: looking now. Alerts show increased token counts + duplicate event IDs from proxy-emitter-7. Not yet confirmed customer-visible overages.

oncall-sre: timeline? any deploys recently?

eng-prod: we deployed tokenizer v2 ~1738801000. There's a small spike of 504s from tokenizer between 1738800900-1738801200. Emitter retries appear to have retried without idempotency dedupe.

billing-eng: quick query run to surface top affected ids:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM metering.events
WHERE emitted_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

billing-eng: top hits: acct-ACME (+42%), acct-FLORA (+27%), acct-XYZ (+18%). Many events show identical request_id hashes.

payments: recommend we pause billing export for the last 1h to avoid noise getting into invoices. Who can flip?

finance: pausing exports is fine short-term. We need a rollback clause and a TTL for the hold.

customer-success: heads up — if this becomes customer-visible we need an ASB ready. Which customers are likely to see flags?

billing-eng: internal overage flags fired for ~2k accounts (mostly low-value tests), production threshold flags for ~150 accounts. Some customers may have received alert emails — verifying.

eng-runtime: mitigation suggestion: add short-circuit on emitter ingestion to drop duplicates for matching idempotency keys older than 30s and return 200 for retries. Can push a config w/ 2 min rollout.

oncall-sre: do it. Also start a dedupe backfill to collapse duplicate events in the last 2 hours. Billing-eng, coordinate retention window.

billing-eng: starting dedupe backfill job now (job-id: dedupe-1738802500). Running in dry-run first to gather list of deduped ids, then apply. ETA ~20-30m for first phase.

ops-bot: CI deploy triggered: emitter-ingest-throttle v1.1 -> canaries (2 hosts). Link: https://ci.internal/deploys/emit-throttle/17388

eng-prod: canary shows 80% reduction in duplicate ingest within 30s of rollout. No downstream regressions observed so far.

customer-success: any evidence customers already billed incorrectly? If so we need to prepare credit playbook.

billing-eng: earliest billing export that could have shipped was at 1738802400. We will hold next export and run a reconciliation-matrix for windows impacted. I'll update with exact customer list in 15m.

payments: after dedupe completes we should run local aggregation to compute delta and decide if soft credits required. Finance, please standby.

finance: standby, we'll wait for a quantified delta. If >0.5% of monthly MR we escalate to leadership.

oncall-sre: interim customer comms — send a short FYI for affected customers: "We detected a brief metering discrepancy; we are investigating and will suppress any erroneous billing alerts while we reconcile." CS to send after we confirm affected list.

customer-success: draft ready, will await billing-eng list and legal signoff.

billing-eng: dedupe dry-run results: ~18k duplicate events across 140 accounts, estimated token delta ~0.9% for impacted customers. Applying dedupe now (applying will remove duplicates from rollout window).

eng-runtime: emitter throttle propagated to all regions. Duplicate ingest rate down to baseline.

billing-eng: dedupe applied. Recalculating aggregates and marking invoices as HOLD for affected customers in export pipeline.

payments: confirm hold applied. We'll stop any downstream invoice sends until reconciliation complete.

oncall-sre: longer-term action items: 1) add stronger idempotency checks at emitter 2) harden retry backoff + jitter 3) improve monitoring for duplicate request_id ratio 4) add runbook step to auto-hold billing exports on large duplicate spikes. Assign eng-prod, eng-runtime, billing-eng, ops.

eng-prod: agreed. Creating follow-ups in tracker.

customer-success: once reconciliation done we'll send targeted comms and offer credits if customers saw increased usage.

incident-bot: Incident status update: METERS_TOKEN_DRIFT -> mitigated (duplicate ingest deduped, emitter throttled). Root cause: tokenizer transient 504s causing retry storms and duplicate events. Postmortem + action items assigned.

oncall-sre: closing pager, but leaving monitoring at high-alert for 2 hours. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
